item.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
item.description: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

item.description: As China's president visits the White House, the Asia Society is visiting South Dakota to get grassroots views on agriculture trade issues.

item.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
item.description: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

item.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
item.description: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.

item.title: Years after storms, clean-up crews meticulously separate the sentimental from the wreckage
item.description: Across the country, lost-and-found networks seek to reunite objects with disaster survivors. The work can take years. In some cases, it's impossible to pick up all the pieces.

item.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died
item.description: James Copenhaver, one of three campaign rally attendees shot in 2024 during an assassination attempt on then-candidate Donald Trump, has died in Pittsburgh, his lawyer said Thursday. He was 76.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
item.description: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.
